item.title: Self-Hosted JMAP Email Servers: Cyrus JMAP vs Apache James vs Stalwart Mail
item.description: The JSON Meta Application Protocol (JMAP) is a modern, RESTful replacement for IMAP, SMTP, and CalDAV. Designed by the IETF (RFC 8620 for data, RFC 8621 for core), JMAP uses JSON over HTTPS to provide a cleaner, more efficient email API — eliminating the IMAP idle/poll cycle, simplifying authentication, and enabling real-time push notifications natively.
